```{python} 
from freqtrade.optimize.hyperopt_tools import HyperoptTools
from pathlib import Path
from operator import itemgetter
from freqtrade.optimize.hyperopt.hyperopt_output import HyperoptOutput


# get epochs generator
foo = HyperoptTools._read_results(hyperopt_path)

# get epochs
results = HyperoptTools.load_filtered_results(hyperopt_path, config)
epochs_len = results[1]  # 16
epochs = results[0]

# Show best epoch config
sorted_epochs = sorted(epochs, key=itemgetter("loss"))
best_epoch = sorted_epochs[0]
params = best_epoch["params_dict"]
HyperoptTools.show_epoch_details(best_epoch, epochs_len, print_json=False)

# print all epochs summary
h_out = HyperoptOutput()
h_out.add_data(config, sorted_epochs, epochs_len, True)
h_out.print()
```

```{python} 

EPOCH_DROP = {
    "params_details",
    "params_not_optimized",
    "results_explanation",
    "results_metrics",
    "params_dict",
}
METRICS_DROP = {
    "trades",
    "best_pair",
    "worst_pair",
    "results_per_pair",
    "results_per_enter_tag",
    "exit_reason_summary",
    "mix_tag_stats",
    "left_open_trades",
    "daily_profit",
    "locks",
}

frames = []
for epoch in epochs:
    params_dict = epoch["params_dict"]
    results_metrics = epoch["results_metrics"]

    data = {
        **{k: v for k, v in params_dict.items()},
        **{k: v for k, v in epoch.items() if k not in EPOCH_DROP},
        **{k: v for k, v in results_metrics.items() if k not in METRICS_DROP},
    }
    frames.append(data)


df = pd.json_normalize(frames)
df["wl_ratio"] = df["wins"] / (df["wins"] + df["draws"] + df["losses"])

first_cols = [
    "is_best",
    "current_epoch",
    "total_trades",
    "wins",
    "draws",
    "losses",
    "wl_ratio",
    "profit_mean",
    "profit_total_abs",
    "profit_total",
    "holding_avg",
    "loss",
    "max_drawdown_abs",
    "max_drawdown_account",
]
cols = first_cols + df.columns.difference(first_cols).tolist()

df = df[cols]
```
